# Subway Seat for Lite XL

Copy the files to `~/.config/lite-xl/colors/`, then pick one in the settings plugin or load it from `init.lua`. Also colours the indentguide and bracketmatch plugins.

[Lite XL](https://lite-xl.com) · [All ports and previews](https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/ports/lite-xl/)

## Files

| Flavor | File | Where it goes |
|---|---|---|
| Subway Seat | [`colors/subway-seat.lua`](colors/subway-seat.lua) | ~/.config/lite-xl/colors/subway-seat.lua |
| Subway Seat Tunnel | [`colors/subway-seat-tunnel.lua`](colors/subway-seat-tunnel.lua) | ~/.config/lite-xl/colors/subway-seat-tunnel.lua |
| Subway Seat Enamel | [`colors/subway-seat-enamel.lua`](colors/subway-seat-enamel.lua) | ~/.config/lite-xl/colors/subway-seat-enamel.lua |

## Turn it on

**Subway Seat**, in ~/.config/lite-xl/init.lua:

```lua
core.reload_module("colors.subway-seat")
```

**Subway Seat Tunnel**, in ~/.config/lite-xl/init.lua:

```lua
core.reload_module("colors.subway-seat-tunnel")
```

**Subway Seat Enamel**, in ~/.config/lite-xl/init.lua:

```lua
core.reload_module("colors.subway-seat-enamel")
```


Generated by `build.py` from `palette.py`. Edit the port in `ports/`, not these files.
